verdict.rationale: Tailscale ships its own Tailscale SSH, which manages authentication and authorization for SSH connections in the tailnet, so the axis applies. Users report reaching machines by MagicDNS hostname without the usual key or credential handling. However, there is no evidence of a saved-host list or one-tap connect, and one user calls Tailscale SSH's browser-based login flow horrible UX, which suggests re-authentication friction. Missing for 10: a documented saved-host / one-tap connect UI, explicit evidence that credentials are never re-prompted, and independent hands-on corroboration of a credential-free experience.
